note: Synthetic demo data for FixMyCircuit. One invented board is shared by all demo models; it is not the layout of any real phone.

guides.title: Stuck on logo or restarting after a drop
guides.symptom: Logo shows, then restarts. Ammeter climbs to about 300 mA, drops to 0 and repeats.
guides.steps:
1. Charge or replace the battery first; a weak battery causes the same loop.
2. Measure the PMIC rails with the phone trying to boot: PP1V8, PP_VDD_CPU, PP1V2 and PP3V0_NAND.
3. A missing PP3V0_NAND or PP1V2 points at the storage area (U7000, bottom side).
4. Check SYS_RST_L stays high once the logo shows.
5. If rails are good, re-flash the firmware before any board work.

guides.title: Not charging, VBUS missing after the port
guides.symptom: No charging icon. USB ammeter shows 0.00 A. Charge port flex tested good.
guides.steps:
1. Open the boardview and search VBUS_IN: it runs J3000 > F3000 / D3000 > U3100 (OVP).
2. Diode-measure VBUS_IN at J3000 and compare with the readings table.
3. Check F3000 for continuity. Open fuse = replace it (the red charging jumper on the photo is only a test).
4. If VBUS_IN reads near 0: suspect D3000 (TVS) shorted. Lift it and measure again.
5. With 5 V present on VBUS, check U3000 (charger) input and its I2C lines (I2C0_SCL / SDA pulled up to PP1V8).

guides.title: No backlight, image faint with a torch
guides.symptom: Picture visible with a torch, screen dark.
guides.steps:
1. Test a known-good screen first.
2. In the boardview click BL_LED_A: J1000 pins, D4000 and the output caps light up.
3. Diode-measure BL_LED_A at J1000. Near 0 = shorted output cap on BL_LED_A.
4. Check L4000 continuity and D4000 in diode mode.
5. Check BL_EN from the SoC goes high with the screen on.

guides.title: Dead, power supply hits current limit
guides.symptom: On the DC supply the current jumps to the limit as soon as the battery connector is powered.
guides.steps:
1. Diode-measure VBAT and PP_VDD_MAIN at J2000 / U3000. Near 0.000 = short.
2. Click PP_VDD_MAIN in the boardview: every decoupling cap on it is a candidate.
3. Inject 1 V at 2 A limit into PP_VDD_MAIN and find the hot part with a thermal camera or rosin.
4. Remove the hot cap and re-measure against the readings table.

guides.title: No touch, display works
guides.symptom: Image is fine but touch does not respond, even with a new screen.
guides.steps:
1. Fit a known-good screen and test again.
2. Check PP3V0_TOUCH at J1000 with the screen on (3.0 V on the demo board).
3. Diode-measure I2C1_SCL, I2C1_SDA, TOUCH_INT_L and TOUCH_RST_L at J1000 and compare with the readings table.
4. An open line reads OL: follow it in the boardview and use the cyan touch jumper as a reference route.
5. Inspect J1000 for bent pins or corrosion.

guides.title: No sound from the loudspeaker, earpiece works
guides.symptom: Ringtone silent, calls are fine on the earpiece. Speaker tested good.
guides.steps:
1. Test with a known-good speaker and clean the contacts.
2. Diode-measure SPK_P and SPK_N at the codec (U5000) and at the speaker pads.
3. Check the filter parts on SPK_FILT_P / SPK_FILT_N for cracks or liquid residue.
4. Check the I2S lines and AUDIO_RST_L to U5000.
5. The purple audio jumper on the photo shows the route used on this demo board.

guides.title: No service or no SIM detected
guides.symptom: Searching or No SIM, IMEI shows. SIM works in another phone.
guides.steps:
1. Clean the SIM tray and check J6000 pins.
2. Check PP_SIM at J6000 with a SIM inserted (1.8 V on the demo board) and diode-measure SIM_CLK, SIM_IO, SIM_RST, SIM_DET.
3. For no service with SIM detected: check the RF_ANT_MAIN feed and the antenna flex.
4. Check PA_EN and the PA (U6100) supply.
5. Compare every reading with the readings table before replacing ICs.
